name: TherapyNotes
description: Note templates, the schedule, insurance billing, a patient portal, and video visits, for a mental-health practice. Horsham, Pennsylvania. Founded 2010 by a clinical psychologist and her husband, who writes software. The price starts at $59 a month.

mentions.evidence: Startup Intros says $0 of outside funding. The revenue estimates conflict. Startup Intros, citing BuiltIn and LeadIQ, says about $21 million a year. Growjo says about $115.8 million. Those are not the same figure, so neither is treated as the number. The $59 price is the menu, not the revenue.
mentions.indieAngle: One founder knows the job. The other writes the code. A profession with its own paperwork can hold one of these.

whyItPrints: A solo therapist pays every month, and the insurance paperwork makes leaving painful. No outside funding, according to a profile.
whyThisMatters: A solo therapist needs the note template, the schedule, the insurance claim, and a portal. TherapyNotes has sold that since 2010, out of Horsham, Pennsylvania.
